notes.title: Game Update - part 2!
notes.content:
Greetings Life in Helsinki fans! You'll be happy to hear a second update is already here and it represents the last part of the well-deserve update. We had a few cosmetic items to fix and we took the opportunity to add a few more fun facts about Helsinki and give the overall script a few improvements.

Again, we'd like to thank everyone that streamed the game or contacted us. Your contribution to help make Life in Helsinki a better experience is truly appreciated!

As before, if you find a typo or anything else, please send over the information so we can address the issue and we can give you all the best visual novel experience we can.

Thank you!

notes.title: Game update!
notes.content:
Hi everyone, first we'd like to thank everyone who took the time to send us emails, who retweetted our posts, who joyfully wrote to us via Instagram and we'd like to thank Twitchers who engaged their followers in fully narrated live streams of Life in Helsinki. A work of fiction is never truly alive until it is experienced by its readers and we are blessed the internet offers us the chance to create games and share them with the world. 

This said, our released needed a well-deserved update and this morning - it's ready! We fixed a few typos, added more fun facts about Helsinki throughout the game, fix the infamous Return to Menu button and more!

If you haven't played the game yet, this the perfect time to do so. If you already have the game, make sure you update it and enjoy this new version!

Final words, like any game released by small or larger teams, it's possible we've missed something. If you find a typo or anything else, please send over the information so we can address the issue and we can give you all the best visual novel experience we can.
